criteria.evidence: secureMkdirAll Lstat-walks each component and secureWriteFile refuses a symlinked leaf; TestApplyStagedRefusesSymlinkAtDestination/InParentDirectory pass.
secureMkdirAll computes filepath.Rel(root, dir), rejects '..' escapes, and verifies every component is a real directory (no symlink) so the parent stays under destRoot.
secureWriteFile opens with os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_TRUNC|syscall.O_NOFOLLOW (unconditional; may not compile on Windows, but builds here).

refresh reads origin via RemoteURL, compares with sameRepository and repairs via SetRemoteURL before fetch/reset; TestRefreshCorrectsATamperedOrigin passes (repair rather than fail/re-clone, as the original also did).
repo.ResolvePushDestination(ctx) resolves `git remote get-url --push` and Publish/publishScaffold print 'pushing to %s (%s)' before Push.
Managed client prepends -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null etc.; TestCommitDisablesHooksForAManagedClient passes and gitops.Open sets Managed: true per the reply.
managedArgs only cover core.hooksPath, commit.gpgsign, tag.gpgsign; nothing in the diff or replies sets GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 or otherwise disables interactive prompting for cache git invocations.
verifyStaged(ctx, repo.Git, []string{rel}) called after Add and before Commit in Publish and publishScaffold; StagedPaths tested, though no direct refusal integration test.
verifyCommitted(ctx, repo.Git, head, expected) runs after Commit and before Push in both paths; CommittedPaths tested.
identity.go keeps effective port; TestSameRepositoryDistinguishesPorts PASS.
Hook/signing -c flags applied only when Client.Managed is true; only gitops.Open sets it.
TestPushRunsHooksForAnUnmanagedClient PASS (user pre-push hook fires for unmanaged client).

ResolvePushDestination returns an error on pushurl/pushInsteadOf mismatch and Publish/publishScaffold return it before Push; TestResolvePushDestinationFailsOnAPushurlOverride/PushInsteadOfRewrite and deploy-level abort tests pass.
Mismatch yields a returned error aborting the push; redirect only accepted when the resolved URL names the configured repo.
Replay reports ok for deploy, git, gitops, release, source and clean go vet on all five packages.
`go build ./... && go test ./...` run shows ok for every package.

judge.reason: The replay implements and tests the symlink guard, origin verification, scoped hook hardening, port-aware identity, exact-path verification and fail-closed push destination, with the full suite and vet passing. However it never disables interactive git prompting for the managed cache (no GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT or equivalent), so n4 is unmet; minor doubt also remains over the repair-in-place reading of c3 and the unconditional syscall.O_NOFOLLOW.
